config.load.code:
YamlConfig config = YamlConfig.builder(plugin.getDataFolder().toPath().resolve("config.yml"))
        .defaults(() -> plugin.getResource("config.yml")) // bundled in src/main/resources
        .logger(plugin.getLogger())
        .build(); // creates the file from defaults if missing, then loads it

config.validate.code:
config.validate()
        .require("storage.type")
        .oneOf("storage.type", "sqlite", "mysql", "mariadb")
        .range("homes.max-homes", 1, 100)
        .type("homes.teleport-delay", Duration.class)
        .check(); // throws ConfigException listing every problem with its line number

config.migrate.code:
return YamlConfig.builder(plugin.getDataFolder().toPath().resolve("config.yml"))
        .defaults(() -> plugin.getResource("config.yml"))
        .version(3) // files without "config-version" count as version 1
        .migration(1, m -> m.move("prefix", "messages.prefix")) // 1 -> 2
        .migration(2, m -> m.set("storage.type", m.has("mysql") ? "mysql" : "sqlite")) // 2 -> 3
        .logger(plugin.getLogger())
        .build(); // old files are backed up as config.yml.v1.<timestamp>.bak before migrating

core.options.code:
bloom = Bloom.enable(
        this,
        BloomOptions.builder()
                .textFormat(
                        TextFormat.MINIMESSAGE) // default format for messages, item names and menu titles
                .unsupportedFeaturePolicy(UnsupportedFeaturePolicy.FALLBACK_TO_CHAT)
                .debug(false)
                .build());

core.services.code:
bloom.services().register(Economy.class, myEconomy); // closed on shutdown if it is AutoCloseable
Economy economy = bloom.service(Economy.class); // throws a descriptive error if missing

events.builder.code:
bloom.events()
        .listen(EntityDamageByEntityEvent.class)
        .priority(EventPriority.HIGH)
        .ignoreCancelled()
        .filter(event -> event.getDamager().getType().name().equals("PLAYER"))
        .handler(event -> event.setDamage(event.getDamage() * 0.8));

bloom.events()
        .listen(BlockBreakEvent.class)
        .limit(1) // unsubscribes itself after the first matching event
        .handler(event -> event.getPlayer().sendMessage("Your first block!"));

items.builder.code:
Items items = Items.of(bloom);
ItemStack sword = items.builder("DIAMOND_SWORD")
        .name("&dBlossom Blade")
        .lore("&7Owner: &f{owner}", "&7Forged under falling petals.")
        .placeholders(Placeholder.of("owner", player.getName()))
        .enchant("sharpness", 5) // modern key; "DAMAGE_ALL" works too
        .flags(ItemFlagKey.HIDE_ENCHANTS)
        .unbreakable(true)
        .glow()
        .build();
player.getInventory().addItem(sword);

scheduling.async.code:
bloom.scheduler()
        .supplyAsync(() -> loadProfileFromWeb(player.getUniqueId())) // background thread: no Bukkit calls
        .thenAcceptAsync(
                profile -> player.sendMessage("Loaded " + profile), // back on the main thread
                bloom.scheduler().mainThreadExecutor());

storage.open.code:
Database db = Database.builder()
        .sqlite(plugin.getDataFolder().toPath().resolve("data.db"))
        .poolName(plugin.getName())
        .migrationTable("myplugin_schema_history")
        .mainThreadCheck(bloom.scheduler()::isPrimaryThread)
        .logger(plugin.getLogger())
        .build();
bloom.services().register(Database.class, db); // Bloom closes it on shutdown, after queued work

storage.migrate.code:
List<Migration> migrations = Arrays.asList(
        Migration.of(
                1,
                "create balances",
                "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS balances (uuid VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY, coins BIGINT NOT NULL)"),
        Migration.of(
                2,
                "add last seen",
                tx -> tx.update("ALTER TABLE balances ADD COLUMN last_seen BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0")));
db.migrate(migrations).join(); // blocking is fine in onEnable, before the server ticks
